readme:
# BambooHR Jobs Scraper: Company Career Sites

Get the open jobs of any company that hires through BambooHR. Paste a career site URL such as `https://acino.bamboohr.com/careers/list` (or just the company name) and receive the jobs with the fields the career site shows as clean dataset rows.

## What you can do with it

- Pull all open roles of a list of target companies for lead generation or recruiting research.
- Track hiring over time: run it on a schedule with `postedWithinDays` (and `includeDescription` on) to see only new postings.
- Feed a job board or alert system with the openings of the companies you follow.
- Filter by keyword in the title and by location.

## What you get

One dataset row per job. Duplicates are removed before anything is charged, so the number of rows is the number of results you pay for.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | Job id, unique across career sites |
| `ats_job_id` | The id BambooHR uses for the posting |
| `title` | Job title |
| `company` | Company name derived from the career site address |
| `company_legacy` | Original company name as the site wrote it, only when the company name was normalised (for example a trailing number removed) |
| `ats_platform` | `bamboohr` |
| `location`, `city`, `country` | City, region and country as posted, the city and the two-letter country code |
| `department` | Department, when the posting has one |
| `employment_type` | Full-time, part-time, contract, internship and so on, when the posting states one |
| `experience_level` | Minimum experience the posting asks for (`Entry-level`, `Experienced`, `Manager/Supervisor` and so on), as written. Filled when `includeDescription` is on |
| `remote` | `true` when the posting is marked remote |
| `workplace_type` | `on_site`, `hybrid` or `remote`, as the posting states it |
| `description` | Full job description as HTML. Empty when `includeDescription` is off or the posting has none |
| `apply_url`, `job_url` | Link to the posting and its application page |
| `created_at` | Date the posting was published (a calendar date). Filled when `includeDescription` is on; empty when it is off |
| `scraped_at` | Time of the run |

Salary fields (`salary_text`, `salary_min`, `salary_max`, `salary_currency`, `salary_period`, `salary_source`) are filled only when the posting states a salary range. They are never estimated.

## Input

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `companies` | BambooHR career site URLs or bare company names (`acino` is `https://acino.bamboohr.com/careers/list`). Strings, `{"url": "..."}` objects, a single string, or several separated by commas or new lines. Empty = one sample career site. |
| `keywords` | Keep only jobs whose title matches at least one keyword. They filter the jobs of the sites you list; they do not search other companies. |
| `location` | Keep only jobs in this city, region or country (`Geneva`, `Switzerland`, `CH`). |
| `countries` | ISO-2 codes such as `["CH", "DE"]`: keep only jobs located in these countries (jobs whose country cannot be determined are left out). |
| `includeRemoteWithoutRegion` | Only with a country filter: also keep remote jobs that state no country or region (they may not be open to applicants in that country). Default `false`. |
| `postedWithinDays` | Drop jobs older than this many days. Needs `includeDescription` on (the posting date is read from the posting); without it every job is kept. |
| `sortBy` | The career site's list has no dates, so both values keep the site's own order. |
| `maxJobsPerCompany` | Cap per career site, counted after the filters. `0` = all. Default 50. |
| `maxResults` | Cap for the whole run. The run stops cleanly when it is reached. `0` = no limit. Default 100. |
| `includeDescription` | Include the description HTML and the stated salary. Default `true`. |

### Example: one career site

```json
{
  "companies": ["https://acino.bamboohr.com/careers/list"],
  "maxResults": 20
}
```

### Example: several career sites with filters

```json
{
  "companies": [
    "https://acino.bamboohr.com/careers/list",
    "https://acme.bamboohr.com/careers/list"
  ],
  "keywords": ["engineer", "data"],
  "maxJobsPerCompany": 25
}
```

Only BambooHR career sites are read. A URL of any other job system (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday and so on) is skipped with a log line that names the actor to use, and is never charged.

### Supported URL formats

- Career site: `https://{company}.bamboohr.com/careers/list` or `https://{company}.bamboohr.com/careers` (with or without `https://`; tracking parameters such as `utm_source` are ignored).
- Posting: `https://{company}.bamboohr.com/careers/{id}` is reduced to its career site; the whole site is read.
- Bare company name: `{company}`.

## Output

```json
{
  "id": "bamboohr-a1b2c3d4-784",
  "ats_job_id": "784",
  "title": "Elektriker 100 % (m/w/d)",
  "company": "Acino",
  "ats_platform": "bamboohr",
  "location": "Liesberg, Baselland",
  "city": "Liesberg",
  "country": "CH",
  "department": "Electric and Automation",
  "remote": false,
  "workplace_type": "on_site",
  "apply_url": "https://acino.bamboohr.com/careers/784",
  "job_url": "https://acino.bamboohr.com/careers/784",
  "created_at": "2025-11-12",
  "scraped_at": "2026-10-28T09:00:00Z"
}
```

The row above is illustrative (the description field is left out for brevity); values depend on the career site.

## Pricing

Pay per result, two events:

- `apify-actor-start`: $0.001 once per run.
- `job-result`: $0.001 per job in the dataset ($1.00 per 1,000 jobs).

The start fee is charged on top of the job results. Filtered-out and duplicate jobs are never charged, and a site that is not found costs nothing. Set a maximum total charge on the run to stop at a budget; the run ends cleanly when it is reached. The pricing box on the actor page always shows the current rates.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Example prompts once connected:**

> "Use `bamboohr-jobs-scraper` for https://acino.bamboohr.com/careers/list and list the open roles with title, location and apply URL."

Configure the MCP server with the BambooHR Jobs Scraper preconfigured at `mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/bamboohr-jobs-scraper`:

```json
{
    "mcpServers": {
        "apify": {
            "command": "npx",
            "args": [
                "mcp-remote",
                "https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=santamaria-automations/bamboohr-jobs-scraper",
                "--header",
                "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_TOKEN>"
            ]
        }
    }
}
```

See the auto-generated API tab on the actor page for language-specific examples (cURL, JavaScript, Python, and more).

## FAQ

**How do I find a company's BambooHR career site URL?**
Open the company's careers page. If the address ends in `.bamboohr.com`, that is the URL. You can pass either the URL or just the company name.

**Can I search by keyword across all BambooHR companies?**
No. Give the URL or name of each company. Keywords only filter the titles of the jobs of the sites you list.

**What if a career site is not found?**
The run continues with the other sites. The run status line names the site and the reason (for example `board_not_found`), and nothing is charged for it.

**Why is `created_at` empty?**
BambooHR shows the posting date on the posting page, which is read only with `includeDescription` on. Switch it on to get `created_at`.

**Why is the salary empty?**
Salary fields are filled only when the posting states a salary range, and only with `includeDescription` on. Nothing is estimated.

**How do I get only new jobs?**
Run it on a schedule with `includeDescription` on and `postedWithinDays` set to the interval (for example `1` for a daily run).

**How do I stop at a budget?**
Set `maxResults` or the maximum total charge of the run. The run stops cleanly when either is reached.

**Why did I get fewer jobs than `maxJobsPerCompany`?**
The caps apply after your filters, and a career site can simply have fewer open jobs. The sites are read in the order you list them, and the run stops once `maxResults` is reached.

## Limits

- Career sites only; no company-name search across BambooHR.
- The posting date and the stated salary are part of the posting page, so `created_at` and the salary fields are filled only with `includeDescription` on.
- With `includeDescription` on, `postedWithinDays` applies to the posting date. Rows always come in the career site's own order, because the site's list shows no dates.
- Many companies have switched their public BambooHR career page off; such a site returns no jobs.
